data.body: [P2] Preserve zero-delay custom retry strategies. `RetryDecision.retry(null)` produces `Duration.ZERO`, and the previous step implementation accepted zero-second delays, but `ExtensionStepResult.retry` rejects durations below one second. Existing custom `StepConfig` retry strategies can therefore terminate the execution with a validation exception instead of retrying. Either retain immediate-retry support in the extension result or normalize zero to the intended supported delay before constructing it, and add a regression test for null/zero retry delays.
